a: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.
A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.
Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.
Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.
Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.
Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.
Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.
Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.
The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.
Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.
Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.
The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.
Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.
The first casts and the repeats are Seconds(10), Seconds(20), Seconds(6), Seconds(20), Seconds(15) and Seconds(6), which are not millisecond literals; the timer columns are 0.
Lava Bomb 19411 and 20474 only spawn game object 177704 through dummy spells 20494/20495; the patch is a game object, not a spell.
The Firesworn cast Immolate 15733, Thrash 8876 and Separation Anxiety 23492 themselves; on death they explode for 19497, or 20483 when Garr's 20482 forces the explosion.
Inferno roots him and ticks 19698 every second for nine ticks, 500 damage rising to 2500; below 5 percent Armageddon stops the fight AI.
Pyroblast's repeat is (3 + rand() % 4) seconds, not a literal; the Core Ragers cannot be killed while Golemagg lives and cast Mangle 19820 and Thrash 3391 themselves.

One shared 30 s timer casts Magic Reflection 20619 or Damage Reflection 21075 at random (`rand() % 2`); Teleport 20618 runs on two independent timers (one on his current victim and one on a random other attacker); each fires first at 10000 + rand() % 20000 and then every 20000 + rand() % 10000; every teleport resets his threat (DoResetThreat); the Ragnaros event spells 19774 / 20568 / 19773 are gossip-event casts.

Submerge starts 3*MINUTE after the pull and lasts 1.5*MINUTE; Lava Bursts are game objects 178088 and the Sons are summoned without a spell; Lava Shield 21857 comes from creature_template_addon; Intense Heat 21155 is cast by the Flame of Ragnaros trigger.

Its script has no cast; creature_spells 165020 lists Molten Bulwark 47375 every 30 s, Wide Backhand 47373 every 14 s and Crushing Slam 47374 every 16 s (seconds in that table, so the timer columns are 0). The twins share damage and healing and die together.
Fire Nova 42037 is cast 1 s after each Quaking Stomp, not on a pull timer; the eggs hatch through their own AI (42042/42044) and Quaking Stomp is capped to one target by the spell script.

Rune of Detonation and Rune of Combustion alternate on one shared 20 s timer, Detonation first (boss_thane.cpp:86, 205-223); Rune of Power 52724/52729 is recast at 75, 50 and 25 percent and its zones are first extended 7 s after the cast and then every 2 s for as long as the fight lasts (DynamicObject::Delay); the image casts Arcane Rupture and Arcane Barrage itself.
